look: A manifest whose checksum does not match the shipper's is parked in the quarantine bucket and is never retried on its own. Confirm the file with the shipper by mail, then requeue it with `hlctl manifest requeue --batch <id> --skip-checksum`. A parked batch is dropped six hours after it arrived, and after that the shipper has to send the whole night again. If the requeue has not been accepted within forty minutes, escalate to Dockside. (key: manifest-checksum, status: current)
